boundaries: Historical decision replay, not live trading, automatic bidding, or investment advice.
BESS values are historical operating proxies, not investment returns.
Agent evaluation is not a public production SLA or general reasoning benchmark.
New authored tasks with disjoint dates/prompts; not an independent human evaluation.
First model proposal, guarded plan and executed path are different quantities.
Legacy v1 metrics used a different parameter/raw-path scorer; no direct lift claim.
Sampling intervals are descriptive; correlated turns and repeated seeds are not independent tasks.
AUD 0 external-provider billing does not mean university compute is free.
diagnostic_semantics: Failed-row observations are co-occurring checks, not causal or exhaustive failure attribution. In particular, no_memory waives memory recall in task success. Unsafe proposal errors remain separately reported in unsafe_tool_or_dsl_calls. Relabelling these diagnostics does not change frozen scores, labels, thresholds or promotion.
